name: Black
title: Check and reformat real Python projects
job: Projects check formatting in CI and apply formatting changes during style migrations. The four timed units are django-reformat, sqlalchemy-check, warm-snippets and editor-ranges. Each project case is one cold `python -m black` process on a fresh original project tree with eight workers. The warm-process API units format documentation code fragments with black.format_str and serve editor range-formatting requests with black.format_file_contents(..., lines=...). Each selected input is visited once per operation without repetition or padding. startup-empty is a separate correctness-only probe on an empty project.
operations: python -m black --check ./lib/ ./test/ ./examples/ setup.py doc/build/conf.py (SQLAlchemy at the parent of its 'update to black 26.3.1' commit, tox.ini CI command; 161 files would be reformatted)
python -m black --quiet --line-length 79 . (original Django tree, in-place formatting changes)
python -m black --check . on an empty project (correctness-only startup probe; not timed as a unit)
black.format_str(code, mode=Mode(...)) per documentation code fragment, one resident warm process (3,765 public fragments)
black.format_file_contents(text, fast=False, mode=Mode(), lines=ranges) per editor range request, one resident warm process (9 public requests)
editable: Python under src/black, src/blib2to3 and src/blackd. pyproject.toml, build settings (mypyc, optimization level, version), grammars and other data files, tests, dependencies, the driver, project trees and inputs are protected.

families.primary: Configured CI --check on an original tree with real formatting violations (SQLAlchemy), plus one realistic narrower-line-length in-place Django reformat. Held-out data applies the same two operations to disjoint projects (google-cloud-retail CI check; Faker line-length-79 migration).
families.startup: Correctness-only empty-project check that bounds process startup share (startup_probe, <= 2%).
families.warm_snippets: Code blocks extracted by blacken-docs from documentation of projects that run the blacken-docs pre-commit hook (and CPython Doc/), each with its project's hook settings; split by repository/organisation.
families.editor_ranges: Complete Python files at a real commit with the line ranges that commit changed (git diff -U0 new-side hunks): CPython Lib/ public, numpy held-out.

size_meaning: Files Black processes per operation (about 1,000 to 2,900) and their total size. API units: number of calls and fragment/file bytes per resident batch.
variables: Project and its pyproject configuration (line length, target versions, extend-exclude)
Check with violations versus in-place reformat
API entry point (format_str vs format_file_contents with lines=) and per-call Mode
options: BLACK_NUM_WORKERS=8; fresh cache and config directories; release native build (HATCH_BUILD_HOOK_ENABLE_MYPYC=true, MYPYC_OPT_LEVEL=3).
outputs: Per operation: exit status, stdout, canonical stderr error headlines/classes and every file and symlink left in the tree, serialized as black-output-v1 and compared by length and SHA-256 with the pinned baseline. Runtime stack frames and addresses are not diagnostic contract data. API units: one canonical black-api-result-v1 JSON per batch holding every per-call result (formatted text, null for NothingChanged, or [exception class, message]), compared by length and SHA-256.
contract: Byte-identical black-output-v1 result per operation; upstream tests keep the baseline's results (native build, plus the mypyc-incompatible tests as pure Python); native build loaded; no helper processes outliving the operation, no caches or files outside declared outputs, no input or evaluator detection, no delegation.
limits: Linux amd64, Python 3.14.6, source-built native Black. Four public performance units (two project CLI operations, warm-snippets and editor-ranges) plus a correctness-only startup probe; held-out operations change symmetrically on disjoint data. No repeated inputs within a unit or padding; units are >= 13 s on the development host and startup share is <= 2%. Upstream tests and unformatted-code controls remain mandatory. Not a cross-platform qualification.
preparation: Pinned Black archive (sha256-checked) committed to /app/black; hash-locked Python dependencies; original Django and SQLAlchemy archives (sha256-checked, complete inventories verified) and an empty project in /app/projects; native baseline prebuilt in /app/baseline-build.
